'''Odacer-Faustin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ERC">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref> with a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] harsh terrain. Heavy [[Water/Legends|snow]] and high winds constantly buffeted the world.

==History==
It was home to a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The academy was founded by [[Darth Drear]], an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] whose power was unmistakable. When the academy was created, Darth Drear built a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith temple|Sith temple]] underneath the [[Odacer-Faustin academy library|library]], which contained scores of ancient Sith lore. Later, he hid his [[Darth Drear's holocron|holocron]] in the temple. Another feature of the academy was the enormous, [[Darth Scabrous's tower|black tower]] that was the central point of the academy. It was here that [[Darth Scabrous]] kept his secret laboratory on the very top of the tower. Nobody at the academy knew about the temple or the holocron except Scabrous and the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Librarian/Legends|librarian]], [[Dail'Liss]]. Darth Scabrous unlocked the secrets in the holocron, which held the secrets to eternal life. This holocron contained a formula and a list of ingredients to create an ancient [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Sith potion]] that granted [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]]. However, this potion killed the subject first, then turned them into a ravenous, cannibalistic [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]].

==Behind the scenes==
Odacer-Faustin is based on a combination of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and the snowy terrain of [[Wikipedia:The Shining (film)|''The Shining'']].<ref name="Joe">{{Suvudu|subdomain=star-wars|url=2010/12/take-five-with-joe-schreiber-author-star-wars-red-harvest.html|text=Take Five with Joe Schreiber, Author, "Star Wars: Red Harvest"|author=Matt Stags|date=2010-12-21}}</ref>
